answer: Require each new agent identity to post a refundable bond locked in a slow-release escrow: like a glacier that only moves when the whole mass shifts, the bond unlocks gradually as the agent completes verified work over weeks. A fraudster spinning up thousands of identities faces a cost that scales with every fake, while honest agents earn the bond back with interest. Like karst water filtering through stone, reputation seeps in slowly and cannot be rushed; a jade seal of standing is granted only after sustained honest participation, and a proven fraud forfeits the bond and burns the identity.
